name: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification
_eligibility_text:
> **For the Trainee (before enrolment) -** 1. The applicant should have passed Class 8th. 1. The applicant should be above the age of 18 years.
> **For the Trainee (after enrolment) -** 1. To ensure that training are viewed seriously, a trainee must attend 80% of the classes/periods to become eligible for a certificate/ for appearing in the end-of-the-course test.
**Note 1:** The batch size of all programs/courses requiring hands-on/practical training should ideally comprise 20 persons **Note 2:** The selection of trainees is to be done in a transparent manner and the same trainee or person should not be selected again. **Note 3:** The students and trainers to be enrolled must be linked to Aadhaar in the Implementing Agency’s records as well as the individual’s Banks account.
